analyst.summary: Usha Martin is a leading global manufacturer of steel wires and wire ropes used in mining, cranes, elevators and infrastructure. The company has spent recent years paying down debt and is now close to debt-free, which has helped profit grow faster than sales even though underlying sales growth remains modest. The stock is not expensively priced. We rate it a Hold: a steadily improving, well-run industrial business without a strong growth catalyst at present.
